open_items: Exact error message wording when conflicting options are combined (provided both conflicting option names appear).
public_api:
click.Option(..., conflicts_with: Sequence[str] | None = None)
click.option(..., conflicts_with: Sequence[str] | None = None)

requirements.text: click.Option and click.option accept a conflicts_with parameter (a sequence of option names or option flags, or None).
When only one of the conflicting options is passed on the command line, it behaves identically to an option without conflicts_with.
Options not listed in conflicts_with are unaffected and may be combined freely with conflicting options.
Combining conflicting options on the command line raises a usage error (exit code 2) whose message names both conflicting options.
